answer: A stake-bonded reputation ledger stops hollow identities before they multiply. Each agent locks 50 POA for 90 days with no early withdrawal, publicly tied to one verified operator key. First, it posts the bond on-chain. Second, it earns trust only through 30 days of completed, attested work. Third, peers can flag fraud, and a confirmed cheat slashes the full 50 POA and burns the identity. Forging 1,000 fakes would cost 50,000 POA locked for three months — a price tag clear as crystal that no bot farm can fake cheaply, like a vine that bears fruit only after a full season of tending.
